datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql:
select case 
when cipinf.MARRIAGE=0 
   then 'Evli' 
   else 'Subay'
   end as new_MARRIAGE,
   case 
   when cipinf.PASSTYPE=0
   then 'Şəxsiyyət vəsiqəsi' 
   else 'Hərbi bilet'
   end as new_PASSTYPE,
   P.id ,
   cust.name as custname,
   cust.OPEN_DAT,
   custinf.LastName as custinfname,
   custinf.name as sorname,
   custinf.soname as fatherName,
   custinf.birthday,
   custinf.birthplace,
   custinf.address,
   custinf.city,
   custinf.work,
   custinf.workplace,
   custinf.phone_m as "Tel mob",
   custinf.Phone_h,
   custinf.Phone_w,
   custinf.e_mail,
   custinf.url,
   custinf.Garanted,
   custinf.PasSer,
   custinf.PaspNum,
   custinf.PaspDate,
   custinf.PaspPlace,
   custinf.Note,
   cipinf.MARRIAGE,
   cipinf.MONTHLYPROFIT,
   cipinf.PASSTYPE,
   cipinf.UNIQUEINSID,
   cipinf.BB_INN,
   cipinf.bb_familystatus,
   cipinf.INSURANCECOMP,
   cipinf.INSPERIODID,
   cipinf.INSPOLICNUM       as "Sığorta polisinin nömrəsi",
   cipinf.insamount         as "Sığorta məbləği",
   cipinf.INSCONTRACTDATE   as "Sığorta müqaviləsinin tarixi",
   cipinf.INSCONTRLASTDATE  as "Sığorta müqa bitmə tarixi" ,
   cipinf.INSCONTRACTPREIOD as "Sığorta müqaviləsinin müddəti"
   
from 
 (select custid,UNIQUEINSID,BB_INN,MONTHLYPROFIT,PASSTYPE,MARRIAGE,INSPOLICNUM,INSPERIODID,insamount,INSCONTRACTDATE,INSCONTRACTPREIOD,INSCONTRLASTDATE,bb_familystatus
,INSURANCECOMP

 from smart.custipinfo 
union
select  custid,null as UNIQUEINSID, null as BB_INN,null as MONTHLYPROFIT,null as PASSTYPE ,null as MARRIAGE,null as INSPOLICNUM,null as bb_familystatus,

null as insamount,null as INSCONTRACTDATE,null as INSCONTRLASTDATE, null as INSCONTRACTPREIOD,null as INSPERIODID,null as INSURANCECOMP

from (
 select id as custid from smart.customers
 minus 
 select custid from smart.custipinfo 
))cipinf,

  smart.customers cust,
  smart.custinfo custinf,
  cm_portfolio P

where
   cust.id = custinf.idcust    and 
   cipinf.custid = cust.id     and
   P.boorowerid= cust.id     
 
  

order by P.id

datasets.name: DataSetKredit
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.id,p.NUMBEROFCREDIT,p.currency, p.boorowerid, p.creditlineamount,a.name ,
       p.annualyinterestrate, p.annualyoverduerate, p.annualypenaltyrate,
       p.dateofconclusion, p.duedatefirstcontract, p.numberofcredit,p.duedatefirstcontract as now_duedatefirstcontract,
       p.purposeofcredit, p.customertype, p.credittype, p.personaltype,
       p.autopayment, p.autoexpire, p.usrgroup, p.branchid,p.annualbankrate,p.newfinanceamount, 
       p.numberofbankcredit,c.description, ROUND(months_between ( p.duedatefirstcontract,p.dateofconclusion)) as dd
 from   cm_active_credits p,  CM_USERGROUPS c, smart.customers a
where 
p.usrgroup=c.id and p.boorowerid=a.id


order by p.id

datasets.name: DataSetIP
datasets.sql:
select b.creditid,p.NUMBEROFCREDIT,a.name, b.predaddress, b.predplatz, b.ownername,
       b.predcost, b.proplawno, b.proplawregno, b.contractno,
       b.contractdate, b.contractnot, b.paperno, b.paperdate,
       b.insuranceamount,
       b.insuranceno, b.insurancedate, b.bankopendate, b.bankclosedate,
       b.givenflatamt, b.handingactdate, b.handingactno, b.resortdate,
       b.alevpredaddress, b.alevpredtype, b.alevpredplatz,
       b.alevownername, b.alevpredcost, b.alevproplawno,
       b.alevproplawregno, b.alevcontractno, b.alevcontractdate,
       b.alevcontractnot, b.alevpaperno, b.alevpaperdate,
       b.alevevaluater, b.alevinsurancecompany, b.alevinsuranceamount,
       b.alevinsuranceno, b.alevinsurancedate, b.regionid,
       b.alevregionid, b.cardid, b.pledgeinslastdate, b.yqiymdate,
       b.paperreregdate,  b.predarea,b.BANKOPENDATE,b.BANKCLOSEDATE,
       b.alevpredarea, b.tickno, t.description, i.description as in_description ,
       q.description as qiy_description, pa.interest,pa.ipinterest,
       CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(LOANACCID)as Ssuda,
       CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(PRIMARYRESERVEACCID)as AdiEhtiyat,
       CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(SECONDARYRESERVEACCID)as MeqsedliEhtiyat,
       CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(DUELOANACCID)as GEcikmishSsdahes,
       CM_COMMON.accountnumber_get(DUEINTERESTACCID)as Gecikmishfaiz,
       p.id,
       p.currency,
       p.usrgroup,
       p.customertype,
       p.branchid
       from 
     cm_ip_info  b,cm_ip_types t,cm_ip_insurances i, smart.customers a,
      cm_ip_qiyms q,cm_accounts ac,cm_portfolio p,
       (select creditid,0 as interest,0 as ipinterest
 from( select id as creditid
from cm_portfolio
minus
SELECT creditid
  FROM cm_payment_schedule 
  group by creditid )
  
union
SELECT creditid, nvl(sum(interest),0) as interest,
       nvl(sum(ipinterest),0) as ipinterest
  FROM cm_payment_schedule 
  group by creditid

) pa
where
b.predtype=t.id
and
b.insurancecompany=i.id
and
b.evaluater=q.id
and
b.creditid=pa.creditid
and
b.creditid=ac.creditid
and
b.creditid=p.id
and
p.BOOROWERID=a.id



order by id

   CM_COMMON.F('url',cust.id)       as url,

   else 'Hərbi bilet'

   a.name as custname,
   a.OPEN_DAT,
   cipinf.MARRIAGE,
   cipinf.MONTHLYPROFIT,
   cipinf.PASSTYPE,
   cipinf.UNIQUEINSID,
   cipinf.BB_INN,
   cipinf.bb_familystatus,

   cipinf.INSPERIODID,

select  custid,null as UNIQUEINSID, null as BB_INN,null as MONTHLYPROFIT,null as PASSTYPE ,null as MARRIAGE,null as INSPOLICNUM,null as bb_familystatus,

   P.boorowerid= a.id
